items.title: Inspect F-009 original claim and current proof surfaces
items.context: Use Lattice CLI and source/doc reads to compare the open F-009 claim with current Layer2 formal proof/evaluator behavior. Do not edit code.

items.title: Decide F-009 closure state with evidence
items.context: Determine whether F-009 is resolved, superseded, or should be narrowed. The decision must distinguish Layer2 Engineering proof from Layer4/Authority/customerKeyRef scope.

items.title: Update B-META finding state through Lattice finding flow
items.context: Use finding_resolve, finding_dismiss, or an equivalent Lattice finding command only after evidence supports the decision. Do not mutate B-META files directly.

items.title: Verify convergence and audit backlog after F-009 triage
items.context: Run convergence_check, finding_list, and gap_analyze. Success means F-009 no longer remains a vague open high/suspected finding; any remaining high gap is explicitly scoped.
